question: What are the three pricing plans offered by CloudSync?
expected_answer: CloudSync offers three pricing plans: Free (10 GB storage, up to 3 team members, 30-day version history), Professional ($12/user/month with unlimited storage and team members, 180-day version history), and Enterprise (custom pricing with everything in Professional plus dedicated support and compliance features).

question: How long does CloudSync keep deleted files before permanent deletion?
expected_answer: CloudSync keeps deleted files in trash for 90 days before permanent deletion. During this 90-day period, you can restore the files.

question: What encryption does CloudSync use for data at rest?
expected_answer: CloudSync uses AES-256 encryption for all data at rest.

question: What is the API rate limit for Professional plan users?
expected_answer: Professional plan users have a rate limit of 1,000 API requests per hour.

question: How long is version history retained on the Free plan?
expected_answer: The Free plan retains version history for 30 days.

question: What payment methods does CloudSync accept?
expected_answer: CloudSync accepts all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover) and PayPal. Enterprise customers can also pay via wire transfer or purchase order.

question: Can CloudSync employees see my file contents?
expected_answer: No, CloudSync engineers do not have access to view file contents. Files are encrypted and only you and people you share with can access them. Engineers may access file metadata (filenames, sizes) for troubleshooting with permission.

question: What happens to my data after I close my CloudSync account?
expected_answer: After account closure, CloudSync retains your data for 30 days to allow account recovery, then permanently deletes all files and data.

question: What is the maximum individual file size supported?
expected_answer: CloudSync supports individual files up to 50 GB. Larger files may need to be split or uploaded using the desktop app's advanced uploader.

question: How many people can edit a document simultaneously?
expected_answer: Up to 50 people can edit a document simultaneously in real-time.

question: What is CloudSync's uptime guarantee for Enterprise customers?
expected_answer: Enterprise customers have a 99.99% uptime SLA. Regular plans aim for 99.9% uptime but without a guarantee.

question: Which file types does CloudSync support?
expected_answer: CloudSync supports all common file types including documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD), images (JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG), videos (MP4, MOV, AVI), and archives (ZIP, RAR, TAR).

question: What happens when a Free plan user reaches their 10 GB storage limit?
expected_answer: When a Free plan user reaches 10 GB storage, they receive warnings at 80% and 90% usage. At 100%, they cannot upload new files until they delete files or upgrade to a Professional plan.

question: Is CloudSync SOC 2 compliant?
expected_answer: Yes, CloudSync is SOC 2 Type II certified.

question: How does CloudSync handle data for users outside the United States?
expected_answer: CloudSync is based in the United States, so data from users outside the US is transferred to and stored in the US. CloudSync complies with applicable data protection laws including GDPR for EU users.

question: What is the refund policy for paid CloudSync plans?
expected_answer: CloudSync offers a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. Customers can contact support within 30 days of their first payment for a full refund.

question: Does CloudSync sell user data to third parties?
expected_answer: No, CloudSync will never sell personal information to third parties. Data is shared only with explicit consent, service providers, for legal compliance, or to protect rights.

question: What programming languages have official CloudSync SDK support?
expected_answer: CloudSync provides official SDKs for Python, Node.js, Ruby, and Go.
